messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate/reranker (model: reranker-v3.2) across us-west-2. Triggered by SLO monitor at 02:15 UTC. Pager sent to oncall.

maria (oncall): Acked. I'm on it — pulling logs now. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy finished: reranker-v3.2 -> prod @ 02:10 UTC by samir-deploy (canary 5%).

maria (oncall): Looks correlated to that canary. Error spike started ~02:14. Getting stack traces from pods.

aaron (infra): I see an increase in OOMs on the inference pool 'infer-rerank-02' around same time. Node memory pressure -> kube restarted a few pods. Logs show: `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` in the model worker.

maria (oncall): Hmm OK. Two parallel mitigations: 1) route traffic away from reranker-v3.2 to fallback model; 2) pin production routing to reranker-v3.1 and scale the infra if needed. Proposing immediate routing change to avoid customer impact while we investigate root cause.

samir (ops): +1 to routing. Draft status page: "We are investigating errors affecting ranked results for some API requests in US-West. Engineers are routing traffic to a safe fallback. Partial degradation expected for ~10-30 minutes." Want me to post it?

jess (customer-success): Please wait 5 mins before posting external comms — we'll prepare a short customer note and attach severity + affected endpoints. Customer-visible impact: some users may see degraded ranking/relevance for autocomplete and search.

maria (oncall): Action items:
- apply routing override to route 100% of reranker traffic in us-west to `reranker-fallback-v2`
- pin model catalog default to reranker-v3.1 for any new requests globally until we confirm fix
- collect model logs and heap dumps from failed pods

aaron (infra): I'm adding a temporary autoscale rule and increasing node memory on infer-rerank-02. Running:
```bash
kubectl patch hpa infer-rerank-02 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'
# bump node pool: gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize infer-group-usw2 --size=6
```

maria (oncall): Routing override applied: `routing-service override set --path /v1/generate/reranker --region us-west-2 --model reranker-fallback-v2 --expires 1800s` -> confirmed 02:24 UTC. Error rate dropping from 6.3% -> 0.8% in 2 minutes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: routing-change: override created by maria (oncall) at 02:24 UTC (id: ov-1884567890-01).

samir (ops): Posting status page now. Draft: "Investigating: Elevated error rates impacting ranking endpoints in US-WEST. Traffic has been routed to a fallback model to mitigate customer impact. Engineers are continuing root cause analysis. Update at 02:40 UTC or sooner." Approved?

jess (customer-success): Approved. Add list of affected endpoints: `/v1/generate/reranker`, `/v1/search/re-rank`. Also mention which customers saw impact if we have that.

maria (oncall): We're collecting request IDs for impacted customers. So far the largest volume was internal QA and a small number of enterprise customers using large-batch reranking.

liam (oncall-next): I'll take the 02:30-03:30 handoff if this persists. LMK when you hand over.

maria (oncall): Handing off at 02:35 UTC — summary for oncall-next:
- Incident: reranker-v3.2 introduced in canary caused OOMs and 5xx errors in us-west inference pool.
- Mitigation applied: routing override to reranker-fallback-v2 in us-west; model catalog pinned to reranker-v3.1 for new requests.
- Infra work: aaron increased node pool and HPA min replicas.
- Next steps: reproduce OOM locally on v3.2, collect heap dumps, run load test with current runtime config.

maria (oncall): Handing off to @liam (oncall-next) 02:35 UTC. All actions logged in incident ticket: https://redwood.incidents/1884567890

liam (oncall-next): Taking it. I'll verify rollback plan and coordinate a minimal canary to validate the fix. If we need a full rollback, we'll schedule a short-maintenance window and communicate.

samir (ops): Customer notification template (internal draft):
"Hi <Customer>,
We detected elevated errors affecting ranked results for some API requests in US-West. We routed traffic to a fallback model to mitigate impact. You may see transient differences in ranking quality. We expect normal service in <=30 minutes. If you see continued issues, please reply and include request IDs or sample queries. — Redwood Inference Status Team"

jess (customer-success): Good. I'll tailor and send to affected enterprise contacts after we confirm list of impacted customers.

aaron (infra): For postmortem: capturing node metrics + heap dumps. Also saving the canary deploy artifact: `reranker-v3.2:sha-abc123` and the runtime config which had reduced heap settings: `-Xmx=2g` (that looks likely related).

maria (oncall): Confirmed root cause hypothesis: v3.2 increases memory usage ~30% at similar QPS; our runtime image had conservative heap flags. We'll add guardrails to deployments: automated mem-profile test in canary and fail canary if mem > threshold.

liam (oncall-next): I'll coordinate a rollback to v3.1 for full traffic in us-west at 03:05 UTC if no further issues. Please leave routing override in place until rollback confirmed.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Monitoring continues. I'll update the incident ticket with heap dumps and logs. Closing the live mitigation thread here and moving to postmortem planning channel in ~2 hours.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place (routing override + infra scaling). Error rate stabilized. Next update scheduled at 03:00 UTC.

samir (ops): Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1884567890 — public note posted at 02:27 UTC.

jess (customer-success): Sent initial batch emails to 3 enterprise contacts at 02:33 UTC. Will follow up with note when rollback completes.

maria (oncall): Final note before handoff: suggested hotfix checklist for eng: 1) reproduce with prod config locally; 2) test v3.2 with increased heap or reduced batch size; 3) if fix available, re-canary behind stricter memory sanity checks.

liam (oncall-next): Got it. Taking over. If anything escalates ping me directly. :phone:
